mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_parent (parent_name, parent_tel_first, parent_tel_middle, parent_tel_last, relation_key, parent_privacy_agree, signature, student_id, created_at) VALUES (#{parentName}, #{parentTelFirst}, #{parentTelMiddle}, #{parentTelLast}, #{relationKey}, #{parentPrivacyAgree},#{signature}, #{studentId}, SYSDATETIME());
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.student_id) FROM erp_parent p JOIN erp_student s ON p.student_id = s.student_id WHERE CONCAT(p.parent_tel_first, p.parent_tel_middle, p.parent_tel_last, '_', s.center_code) = #{groupKey}

SELECT TOP 1 es.sibling_key FROM erp_parent p JOIN erp_student s ON p.student_id = s.student_id JOIN erp_sibling es ON p.student_id = es.student_id WHERE CONCAT(p.parent_tel_first, p.parent_tel_middle, p.parent_tel_last, '_', s.center_code) = #{groupKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_sibling (sibling_key, student_id, center_code, created_at) SELECT #{siblingKey}, p.student_id, s.center_code, GETDATE() FROM erp_parent p JOIN erp_student s ON p.student_id = s.student_id WHERE CONCAT(p.parent_tel_first, p.parent_tel_middle, p.parent_tel_last, '_', s.center_code) = #{groupKey} AND p.student_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM erp_sibling)
INSERT INTO erp_sibling (sibling_key, student_id, center_code, created_at) SELECT #{siblingKey}, #{studentId}, #{centerCode}, GETDATE() WHERE #{studentId} NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM erp_sibling)
